name: FLA_ASSET_SERIALS_INT
description: FLA_ASSET_SERIALS_INT contains the asset serial information like asset number, serial number, employee tagged with asset serial etc.

columns.name: INTERFACE_SERIAL_ID
columns.description: Interface Asset serial identifier. This column consistutes primary key along with LOAD_REQUEST_ID column of the table.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Interface Asset identifier from the assets interface table FLA_ASSETS_INT for which the serial details are defined.

columns.name: INTERFACE_LEASE_ID
columns.description: Interface Lease identifier. It references the primary key of the FLA_LEASES_INT table.

columns.name: EMPLOYEE_ID
columns.description: Employee with whom the asset is tagged with.

columns.name: EMPLOYEE_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: E-mail address of the employee to whom the asset is assigned.

columns.name: INSTALL_SITE_ID
columns.description: Site information at which the asset is being installed

columns.name: INSTALL_SITE_CODE
columns.description: Physical location of the inventory asset.

columns.name: SERIAL_NUMBER
columns.description: Asset serial number to uniquely identify each asset.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: AMEND_ACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Amend action type which identifies which action is being performed. Values could be INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: Asset number of asset to which the serial is associated.

columns.name: EXISTING_SERIAL_NUMBER
columns.description: Existing Serial Number. Existing asset serial number.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
